Commentary.Commentary: Earlier in the day, Azhar Ali and Sarfraz Ahmed stitched together an 86-run partnership. After Sarfraz gifted his wicket away, Ali and Nawaz dug in but couldn't carry it long. The soft dismissal of Ali for 91 jolted their lower order and it was quite an eventful and dramatic passage of play after that. The Windies are favourites and they haven't lost a match whenever they have chased below 200. Expect the home side to fight brilliantly till the end.

West Indies haven't wasted any time after lunch as they have come back hard and have run through the lower order and tail in a jiffy. A lion-hearted performance from them with the ball and in the field. They held onto the catches and put in their best. Holder shone with the ball as he grabbed a 5-fer and bowled with terrific rhythm. The visitors are in the driver's seat now as they only require 153 to win and avoid a whitewash.

OUT! The decision stays as it! Jason Holder bags his maiden Test 5-fer, what a time to get it! Angles in a length delivery on middle, Yasir gets forward to flick it across the line only to be hit on the pads. An appeal is made and the umpire raises his finger. Yasir Shah takes the review and the replays show it was hitting middle and leg. PAKISTAN HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 209 AND LEAD BY 152 RUNS!
Yasir Shah is given out LBW but he takes the review straightaway. Looks like he is a goner.
Banged in short on middle, Shah ducks to evade it.
Short of a length delivery, tucked towards the leg side.
FOUR! Now comes the pull! Bishoo drops it short on middle, Babar camps back and pulls it with disdain towards mid-wicket to collect back-to-back boundaries. Lead goes past 150 now!
SIX! Boom! Bishoo gives this one a truck full of flight. Babar stands his ground and hits it dead straight back over the bowler's head for a biggie all the way. Valuable runs those!
Floated ball around off, defended back to the bowler.
Very full around middle, bunted back to the bowler.
Tossed up delivery around middle and off, Babar pushes it through point and comes back for a couple.
Around middle and off, Babar looks to defend but fails to put any bat on it.
Jason digs it hard on middle, Shah sits under it.
An overpitched ball outside off, Babar drives it through covers. It wasn't timed that well but they get three.
ZULFIQAR BABAR is the last man in!

OUT! West Indies are on a roll here! Holder slants this on on middle and leg, Riaz gets back to tuck it on the leg side but ends up spooning a straight forward catch to Johnson at short leg. That wasn't an easy catch at all by any means but Leon showed great reflexes. West Indies are on the verge to wrap it up quickly.
Angles a length delivery on middle, Riaz misses his tuck and gets an inside edge on the pads.
Fuller in length and outside off, pushed towards covers.

NOT OUT! Yorker on middle and leg, Yasir looks to flick but misses and is hit on the pads as the ball rolls towards the leg side. Holder appeals for LBW but the umpire shakes his head. They take it upstairs and replays show it was clearly going down leg. A leg bye is taken.
AN LBW appeal against Yasir Shah is referred upstairs!
Drinks are on the field! YASIR SHAH is the next man in, replacing Amir.

OUT! DRAMA! SENSATIONAL EFFORT FROM CHASE IN THE DEEP! What an eventful ball and Amir has been run out finally. Tossed up, he hits it aerially to long on where Chase runs a bit backwards and takes the catch. But he realizes the momentum will take him over the ropes, so he throws the ball back. He gets up and hurls in a throw at the non-striker's end. Amir stands there admiring his shot but he has to speed down to the other end to complete a single. Holder collects the throw cleanly and flicks the bails off. Looks like Amir is short of the crease. The TV umpire first checks whether Chase has been able to keep the ball in play. The replays show that he flicked it in just at the nick of time. Now, time to check for the run out. The replays show that he was way short of the crease. Poor from Amir as he was too casual to get back. The home side lead by 136.

Complete drama out there. Firstly they are checking upstairs if Chase has saved a six at long on. He then fires a throw at the bowler's end where Holder removes the bails. Amir is short but the only question is, has Chase done it neatly?
Amir defends it from the crease.

CLOSE SHAVE! Tossed up around off, spinning in. Amir prods forward to defend but is hit on the pads first and it goes on to kiss the gloves. The ball lobs towards the fielder at short leg but lands just in front. There is a muted appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Riaz sweeps this one through mid-wicket for a single.
Amir goes for the heave but inside edges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up on off, spinning in. Amir prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. There is a stifled appeal for LBW but in vain! The replays confirm an inside edge.
Bouncer around off, Riaz takes his eyes off but manages to sway away from the line.
Full delivery outside off, driven nicely to the covers but not in the gap.
Riaz ducks underneath the bouncer and lets it go.
Angling into the hips, tucked through square leg for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Amir lets it go.
Comes from around the wicket and bowls a fullish ball on off, Amir comes forward and blocks.
JASON HOLDER is back on for a spell!
Lands it on a length, Riaz looks to glide it down to third man but gets an inside edge that goes to hit him on the body. Lucky that it didn't roll onto the stumps.
WAHAB RIAZ is the next man in, replacing Ali!

OUT! OH GOD! ALI DEPARTS IN A WEIRD MANNER! Bishoo bowls a full and loopy ball outside off, Ali first shapes to play the sweep but changes his mind at the last moment. Opens his bat face and guides it straight to Darren Bravo at first slip who takes a well- judged catch. A soft dismissal and he is kicking himself! Misses out on a century too. WI are on top now. Pakistan lead by 133.
Ali goes back and defends it to the off side.
Full on middle and leg, Ali comes forward and defends.
Amir fetches it from around off and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Amir pushes it gently to the covers.
Back of a length ball at the stumps, Ali hops back and defends it down the pitch.
Ali ducks underneath the bouncer and evades it!
Five Wides! One of the widest wides you would ever see! Loses his grip on the ball and lands it outside the pitch on leg side. The ball heads down to the boundary.
Dug in short targeting the rib cage area, Amir rises with the bounce and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
Fullish ball around off, Ali strides forward and pushes it down to mid off for a single.
Length delivery attacking the stumps, Amir stays back and defends it towards mid on for a single.
Fullish on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, cut towards point.
Amir comes half forward and defends it to the leg side.
Slow through the air and outside off, Amir prods forward and defends.
Amir drives it against the spin wide of mid off.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tossed up outside off, Amir drives it to the cover region.
Shortish delivery going down leg, Ali looks to flick it but misses.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a back of a length ball at the stumps, Ali hops back and works it down the leg side.
Targeting the rib cage area this time, Amir nudges it round the corner for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, Amir camps back and punches it to point.

DROPPED! WHAT HAVE YOU DONE SKIPPER? Need to hold onto those! Back of a length ball angling across Amir. He slashes away from the body and gets a thick outside edge that flies towards Holder at gully. He sticks his right hand out but the ball goes through his hands. The ball rolls onto the deep. Couple taken!
On the hips, nudged towards fine leg for a single.
A tad short outside off, Amir punches it towards cover-point.
Full and outside off, Amir defends it towards the off side.
MOHAMMAD AMIR is the new man in, replacing Nawaz!

OUT! BRILLIANT CATCH BY LEON JOHNSON! Tossed up on off, turning in. Nawaz plants his front foot forward to negotiate the spin but gets a faint inside edge that goes onto brush his pads and flies to the left of Johnson at short leg. He reacts sharply and takes a brilliant catch bending low to his left. WI are overwhelmed. An important breakthrough. Pakistan lead by 119 now.
Tosses it up nicely on off, Nawaz prods forward to defend but gets an inside edge onto his body that falls safely on the track.
A tad short outside off, stays low. Ali camps back and cuts it through cover-point for a single.
On a length, outside off. Nawaz helps it with the turm through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length ball on off, Ali hops back and defends it on the off side.
Outside off, left alone.

On a length angling across Nawaz. He camps back and pushes it towards covers. Bishoo doesn't collect it cleanly and the stutter in running between the wickets doesn't cost them a wicket. Single safely taken!
Fullish delivery angling into middle, Nawaz plants his front foot forward and defends down the track.
Full length ball, tailing  into the stumps. Ali comes forward and pushes it with the inner half of his bat wide of mid on for a single.
Short of a length ball around off, angling in and stays a touch low. Ali looks to tuck it around the corner but misses and is rapped on the thigh pad.
Well bowled! Tossed up outside off, inviting Nawaz for the ambitious drive. He resists the temptation and defends it into the ground.
Very slow through the air and on middle and leg, Nawaz nudges it round the corner.
A tad short outside off, turning away. Ali cuts it through covers for a single.
On a length, spinning away. Ali stays back and defends.
Nawaz camps back and pushes it to the off side for a single.
Slow and full outside off, Nawaz pushes at it tamely and gets beaten. The keeper flicks the ball in a jiffy but Nawaz was in.
Full ball on off, Ali puts his head down and defends. Pakistan lead by 113.
Outside off, left alone by Ali.
BRAVE LEAVE! On a length outside off, angling in sharply. Ali plants his front foot forward and lets it go. The ball whizzes past the off stump.
FOUR! BEAUTIFUL TIMING! Fractionally overpitched outside off, Ali drives it on the up and the ball goes past the diving mid off fielder and into the boundary.
Fullish length ball outside off, left alone by Ali.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ali comes forward and mistimes his drive to mid off.
FOUR! SHOT! Full outside off, Nawaz drives on the up and gets it through the covers. Brathwaite gives a chase but fails to save the boundary.
Mohammad drives it against the spin to mid off.
Goes back this time and defends it to the off side.
Similar delivery, turning in on middle this time, Nawaz defends it to short leg.
On a length, spinning into Nawaz. He goes back and punches it towards mid off.
Tossed up on off, Nawaz lunges forward in defense.
Full length ball tailing in around off, Ali pushes it down the track.

Fullish delivery bowled a bit wider from the crease, reversing into Ali. He looks to clip it through but seems to have got an inside edge onto his pads. There is a stifled appeal for LBW but not given. The replays show that it was probably going down leg too.
On a length around off, angling in. Azhar stays in the crease and defends it with the inner half of his bat towards short mid-wicket.
Fuller length ball outside off, Ali points his bat skywards and lets it through.
Full toss outside off, driven straight to the man at covers who fumbles a bit but no runs taken. Failed to capitalize on that one!
On a length on off, angling in. Ali looks to clip it square but is hit on the thigh pad.
ALZARRI JOSEPH comes into the attack. A slip and a gully in place.
Ali punches it to deep point for a single.
A tad short outside off, Nawaz camps back and punches it wide of mid off where Carlos Brathwaite covers ground and dives to make a good save. Single taken!
Nawaz stays back and defends the length delivery down the pitch.
Nawaz plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Similar delivery, driven wide of mid off fielder who comes to right to cut it off.
Tossed up around off, Nawaz prods forward in defense.

We are back for the second session of play. The players and umpires walk back in the middle. AZHAR ALI and MOHAMMAD NAWAZ to continue their innings. DEVENDRA BISHOO to continue his spell. Here we go...
...DAY 4, SESSION 2...

Shannon Gabriel has tried hard but hasn't been that consistent and the skipper has failed to produce the same heroics as yesterday. Bishoo has been a touch too short and has failed to trouble the batsmen though he got lucky to pick up a wicket. A lot depends on the pair of Ali and Nawaz and the visitors would like to see the back of the former soon. A lot to still play for. Join us in a bit for the post-lunch session.

A decent session for Pakistan as they have stretched the lead to 103 but they are still not out of the jail. They will take heart from the fact that Azhar Ali has put his head down and is nearing his century. He needs to carry on if Pakistan hope to post a competitive total. Earlier in the morning after playing some delightful shots, Sarfraz Ahmed will be gutted as he gifted his wicket away.
Azhar Ali gets back and turns this loopy ball towards short fine leg. THAT'S LUNCH ON DAY 4!
Around middle and leg, worked towards deep square leg for a single.
Flighted ball around off, Nawaz defends it nicely.

FOUR! A bad ball and Nawaz cashes on it! A long hop around off, Nawaz camps back and cracks it through cover-point for a boundary. No one in the deep and the batsman gets a boundary. Lead goes past 100 now!
Tossed up delivery around middle, Ali flicks it through square leg for a single.
Full and around middle, bunted back to Chase.
ROSTO CHASE to bowl the final over before lunch...
Loopy ball around off, turning in sharply. Nawaz stands back and flicks it towards backward square leg.
Ali gets down and across, brings out the paddle sweep as he hits this one through square leg for a single.
Floated ball around off, pushed towards the off side off the front foot.
Ali plunges forward and drives it towards covers.
Gives this one a bit more air around middle, worked through square leg for one.
Tossed up delivery around off, Nawaz blocks it out.
Ends up slipping this one on the pads, it's flicked in front of square for just a single.
Comes from around the wicket and angles it on middle and leg, Nawaz lunges forward and defends it into the ground.
Fullish in length on off, Ali opens the face and glides it through gully for a single to bring up 150 for Pakistan!
Short of a length delivery, served outside off. The Pakistan ODI skipper arches back and evades it.
Fuller and curling in this time, Ali gets across and wrists it towards mid-wicket.
On a good length and outside off, Azhar hangs back and defends it back to Holder.
Prods forward and shows a solid defense.
Flatter ball around middle, punched down to long off for a single.
Loopy delivery around off, AA pushes it back to the bowler.
Gets behind the line and digs it out on the off side.
Flatter ball around middle and leg, flicked past short leg for a run.
There is a field change as Nawaz is on strike. A short leg and silly point in place.
Tossed up ball around middle and off, eased down to long on for a single.
In the channel outside off, Nawaz shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller in length and around off, Mohammad steps forward and tries to drive it through covers but finds the man there who fumbles a bit but does well to stop it in the end.
Fuller and slanted across the batsman. Nawaz doesn't fiddle with it.
Bangs in short on leg, Nawaz sits underneath it.
Strays it on the pads, Nawaz clips it through square leg and comes back for a double. This should ease his nerves as he is finding it really tough out there.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ali plays with an angled bat towards point for a single.
JASON HOLDER is back on!

A shout for a caught behind! Loopy ball around middle, turning in as well. Nawaz goes back to flick but misses and Dowrich behind the stumps collects it. He then along with the bowler goes up in an appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. They think about reviewing it but then decide against it. Replays show it brushed his pads and there was no involvement of the wood.
Tossed up ball around off, worked towards silly mid on.
Outside off, turning in, Nawaz gets back and flicks it towards short fine leg.
Full and around middle, nudged towards square leg for a single.
Floated ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Fuller and skidding in around off, Ali covers the line and defends it.

Comes from over the wicket and bangs it on middle at 142 kph. Nawaz is surprised by it and ends up taking a blow on the right shoulder as the ball just goes past the man at short leg. Gabriel loses his balance in the followthrough and falls down on the ground.
Very full outside off, Mohammad has got nothing to offer to that one.
Back of a length delivery on off, played on the up towards covers.
Switches to around the wicket and bowls it on off, Nawaz pushes it towards the off side.
Comes from over the wicket now and hurls in a length ball, angling in, Ali flicks it towards fine leg for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ali shoulders his arms to that one.
Full and down the leg side, Nawaz lets it go.
Full and around off, pushed towards mid off.
Flattish on middle and off, Nawaz covers the line and defends it.
Loopy ball around middle and off, buried into the ground.
Skids in from outside off, the batsman leaves it alone.
Tossed up delivery around off, Nawaz defends it gently.
Fuller in length and outside off, Azhar leans into it and drives it straight to point.
Wide! Full and very, very wide outside off to make Azhar Ali go after it.
Touch short and around off, Nawaz taps it towards covers and gets off the mark.
Fires it full and outside off, Nawaz lifts his bat and lets it go.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, Mohammad stays back and answers it with a straight bat.
Short and slanting down leg, Nawaz ducks under this one.
Fullish ball around off, driven straight to mid off for a single.
Leans into the shot and keeps out on the off side.
Around off, turning in, Nawaz works it with the turn towards the leg side.
Full around middle and leg, Nawaz digs it out at the last moment.
Around middle and leg, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Cuts this flat bat through point for a single.
Tossed up around middle and off, Ali defends it off the front foot towards the off side gently.
Too full and outside off, Nawaz lets it go.
That's a lovely ball! Fuller in length and just outside off, holding its line as well. Nawaz comes forward with a mindset to defend but is lucky not to edge it to the keeper.

Comes from around the wicket and bowls a wayward delivery down the leg side. The batsman has got nothing to do and the poor keeper dives full length to his right but fails to collect. Two byes picked up.
Fuller ball outside off, Ali presses forward and drives it towards covers where the fielder dives to his left to stop it. The ball goes off the fingers and they take a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, Ali drives it straight to the man at covers.
Good length delivery, angling in, Azhar makes a careful leave.
SHANNON GABRIEL is back into the attack!
Hangs back and defends it with a straight bat. End of a successful over!
Gets behind the line and offers a solid defense yet again.
Tossed up around off, defended gently.
Loopy ball from around the wicket, Nawaz presses forward and defends it down.
MOHAMMAD NAWAZ comes into bat.

OUT! Edged and taken! Bishoo breaks the crucial stand of 86 runs! Flatter and short outside off, Sarfraz Ahmed gets back to cut but ends up guiding it into the safe hands of Bravo at first slip who pouches it with ease. That shot was on but it was poorly executed as he lost his balance while play at it. Pakistan now have lost half their side and lead by just 78 runs.

That's a poor ball! Full and down the leg side, Ali gets down and sweeps it towards fine leg. It was all set to race towards the fence before Joseph came running to his right, put in a dive. The umpire checks it upstairs if he made contact with the rope when the ball was in his hand. He didn't and Pakistan get three.
Comes forward and works it past mid on to keep strike.
Loopy ball around off, defended from within the crease watchfully.
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Ali looks to flick but gets a leading edge back to the bowler.
Flatter one around middle, Ahmed punches it past the non-striker for a single.
Around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Starts with a short ball around off, Sarfraz backs away and cuts it straight to the man at backward point.
ROSTON CHASE into the attack, which means spin from both ends now!
Bishoo sees Sarfraz coming down the track and hence fires it full on the stumps. Sarfraz somehow digs it out towards mid-wicket. A single taken.
Fuller on the stumps, Ahmed digs it back to Bishoo.
Flatter through the air on off, cut towards point.
Loopy ball around off, Ali drives it towards mid off for a single.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot gently.
Loopy ball around leg, Sarfraz gets back and flicks it towards backward square leg for a single.

Time for Drinks! A good first hour for Pakistan as Sarfraz and Ali have steadied the ship nicely and already shown signs of battling hard. West Indies will need to bowl with more venom if they have to get a breakthrough here. Will these two see off till Lunch? Let's wait and find out.
Back of a length ball outside off, Ali rides the bounce and defends it towards covers. Wants a single but is sent back. End of a maiden over.
Almost a yorker length ball on off, Ali digs it out to the off side nicely.
Fuller length ball wide outside off, Azhar doesn't flirt with that one.
Good length ball that is straight, Ali camps back and defends it solidly. He is looking set for a big one and West Indies need to see the back of him soon.
Similar delivery, Ali defends it with the inner half of his bat to the leg side.
Pacy delivery on a length on off, Azhar covers the line and defends from the crease.
A tad short outside off, cut through cover-point for a single. Pakistan lead by 70.
Ahmed comes down the track and pushes the loopy delivery to long off for a single.
Ali kneels and sweeps it nicely behind square leg for a single.
Outside off, spinning away. Ali prods forward and defends it to short cover.
He strides forward again and defends down the track.
Full and loopy on off, Azhar comes forward and defends to the off side.
Full length ball outside off, driven firmly towards covers but fails to pierce the gap.
Back of a length ball at the rib cage area, Ahmed plays it with soft hands towards short mid-wicket.  Ali wants the single but is sent back.
Angling down leg, nudged round the corner for a single. Joseph is not bowling with good rhythm!
Very full ball on leg stump, Azhar comes forward and defends it to mid-wicket.
On a length angling into the pads, played towards short mid-wicket.
FOUR! EASY PICKINGS! Full toss on leg stump, Ali tickles it round the corner and the ball races to the fence.
A tad short at the stumps, spinning in this time. Ahmed camps back and whacks it to the fielder at mid on.
Ahmed drives this one to extra cover.
Very slow through the air and outside off, Ahmed plays it towards point from the crease.
Full on middle and leg, Ahmed comes forward and defends it down the track.
On a length outside off, spinning away. Azhar stays back and cuts it through covers for a single.
Loopy delivery on middle, Sarfraz hangs back and pushes it to mid on for a single.
DEVENDRA BISHOO comes into the attack.
Fullish ball outside off, shaping in. Ali comes forward and points his bat skywards to leave it.
Shortish delivery on off, doesn't bounce much. Azhar camps back and defends it.
Straying on the hips, nudged to deep backward square leg for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, Ahmed camps back and defends stoutly.
Fullish delivery attacking the stumps this time, Ahmed prods forward and clips it towards mid on.
A wayward delivery to begin with! Sprays it way down the leg side, Sarfraz has nothing to do with it.
ALZARRI JOSEPH comes onto bowl.
Short ball again and Ali has no trouble in ducking underneath it. Pakistan lead by 59 now.
Bouncer on middle and leg, Azhar ducks under it nicely and lets it sail through to the keeper.
Short ball directed at the rib cage, Sarfraz gets on top of it and tucks it down to fine leg for a single.
On a length, reversing down this time. The ball perhaps sits a bit on the pitch as Sarfraz looks to clip it down to fine leg but misses.

Back of a length ball on middle, Azhar tucks it towards mid-wicket and sets off for the run. Ahmed is a bit lazy in getting across but makes it safely at the end as the shy from the fielder was off target.
Full length ball on off, Ali lunges forward and plays a good looking off drive for no runs.
Good change of pace on off again, Sarfraz prods forward and defends it nicely.
Goes wider of the crease and bowls it fullish at 145 clicks on off, Ahmed is deceived a bit by the pace as he goes half forward and defends it.
Slower ball on middle and leg, Ahmed prods forward and defends it towards mid-wicket.
Dug in short this time, angling down leg. Ahmed ducks under the bumper easily.
Ali drives it sweetly but is unfortunate that the ball hits the stumps at the non-striker's end and deflects to mid on. Single taken!
Fullish ball outside off, Ahmed leans forward and pushes it through point for a single.
Full length ball on off, Azhar puts his head down and defends it solidly. Maiden from Holder!
On a length, angling in. Ali shuffles and clips it towards mid-wicket.
Fullish delivery, reversing back a touch, Ali plays it towards mid-wicket.
Bouncer that is going down leg, Ali ducks underneath it.
OH! THAT MISSED BY A WHISKER! An off cutter outside off, that grips and turns. Ali perhaps didn't pick it up and leaves it. The ball just goes past the off stump. Risky leave that one.
In between full and good length on off, Ali strides forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Angling into the pads, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Azhar covers the line and defends it nicely to the off side.
On a length shaping in on off. A hint of reverse swing on that as Ali leans forward confidently and pushes it back to the bowler.
22nd Test fifty for Azhar Ali!

FOUR! Angling down leg, Ali manages to get some bat on that and the ball races to the boundary. Reaches his 50 and it has been a really, really crucial knock! He knows his job is not done and he needs to carry on to bail Pakistan out of trouble!
Fullish ball angling in late at the stumps, Ali covers the line and clips it expertly through mid-wicket for a couple. Pakistan lead by 50 now.
Fuller length ball outside off, Azhar waits for it and defends it with an angled bat towards gully
Full length ball outside off, driven towards covers for a single.
Almost a replica of the previous delivery and Azhar sways away from the line.
Bouncer that is well directed! On middle and leg, Ali drops his wrists and sways away from the line.
Dug in short on middle, Ali ducks under it and lets it go.
Fullish delivery angling in on off stump, Azhar leans forward and clips it to mid on.

Back of a length ball outside off, Ahmed punches it through the covers for a couple. An off target throw allows them to come back for the third. Had it been on target and Holder collected it, Sarfraz could have been a goner!
Full toss on leg stump, flicked through square leg for a single. Lead is 44 now.
Attemps the yorker again but gets it on the pads, Azhar clips it through mid-wicket for a single.
Follows it up with an excellent yorker on middle and leg to catch him off guard. Ali is up to it as he digs it out nicely.
On a length outside off, Azhar camps back and punches it towards covers.
The idea is to bounce him out and there is a short leg and gully specifically for that! Digs it short again but gets it down the leg side, Ali ducks under it easily.
50-run stand between Ali and Sarfraz!
Dug in short on middle and leg, Ahmed mistimes his pull behind square for a single.
Good bouncer! Dug in short around off, Ali watches it closely and drops his wrists to let it through.
Back of a length ball rising on Ahmed. He swivels across and pulls it down to fine leg for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, on a driving length. Ahmed comes forward but mistimes his drive towards covers.
Good length ball outside off, Sarfraz hangs back and defends it towards point.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Short and wide outside off, Sarfraz lifts his bat and smashes it behind gully. The ball races to the fence! He has begun well here!
On a length and at the stumps, Sarfraz tucks it towards mid-wicket.
JASON HOLDER to bowl from the other end.
Bowls in a well directed bouncer on middle and leg, Ali ducks under it and lets it sail through to the keeper.
Good running between the wickets! On a length angling into Sarfraz. He rides the bounce and plays it with soft hands towards short mid-wicket for a brisk single.
On a good length outside off, Ahmed hangs back and defends it towards short cover. Good techinque to play that one!
Shannon Gabriel comes steaming in but Sarfraz wasn't ready and poor bowler has to pull out at the last moment.

FOUR! BEAUTIFULLY PLAYED! Width on offer and Ahmed latches onto it. Ahmed prods forward and square drives it towards point. The fielder slows down the ball a bit but it has enough legs to reach the boundary.
Fullish delivery outside off, Ahmed strides forward confidently and plays it with an angled bat towards gully.
On a length outside off, Ahmed stays back and dabs it towards gully.

We are ready to kick start the proceedings of Day 4. The players and umpires make their way out in the middle. AZHAR ALI and SARFRAZ AHMED will continue their innings. The latter will take strike. SHANNON GABRIEL will bowl first up with a slip and gully in place. The first hour would be crucial for both the sides. Here we go...

Pitch report - Bazid Khan reckons that the rough marks just outside of leg stump of the right handed batsman, will help the spinners. Also, on the off side there are spike marks which will support the spinners. Though it is Day 4, the pitch is still decent for batting but the short ball will be a threat even though the pitch has become slower.

The hosts are in a precarious situation and the partnership between Azhar Ali and Sarfraz Ahmed is of utmost importance for them. The pitch is still a decent one to bat on and has not crumbled substantially. Both of them have high responsibility on their shoulders to steer their ship to safety. This could well turn out to be the deciding day. A lot still remains at stake!

Hello and a warm welcome on day 4 of the third and final Test match between Pakistan and West Indies in Sharjah. The visitors are on top for the first time in the Test series and have a great opportunity to stamp their authority. Their bowlers need to continue bowling testing lines and lengths. We would see more of Bishoo today as he can prove to be a handful on this track.
...DAY 4, SESSION 1...

Batting last in the sub-continent is never easy and West Indies will want the lead to be restricted as much as possible. It is now 31 with Pakistan still having six wickets in the bank. It's been another compelling day of Test cricket with the momentum swinging from one team to the other and vice versa. Tomorrow promises to be another cracking day in prospect. Do join us at 1130 IST for all the coverage. Till then, it's good bye from us.

Despite the mayhem at the other end, Azhar Ali has looked solid and along with Sarfraz ensured that there weren't further alarms. Both batsmen looked vulnerable to the rising ball but dug in. Holder was the standout bowler for the hosts while Gabriel too worked up steam. The latter would have had Sarfraz but for his customary no ball habit. The tourists looked pumped up in the final session and have Pakistan on the mat currently.

Yet another good day for the Windies - they've won all the days played so far and are sitting pretty at the moment in this Test match. Brathwaite and the lower order stretched the visitors' lead to 56 earlier in the day with the opener carrying his bat. Although Pakistan survived till tea without losing a wicket, Holder led a strong fightback to reduce the hosts to 48/4 in the final session with Shafiq getting a pair.
The umpires have decided that the light isn't adequate for play to continue. It's been the same for the last two days as well at this time of the day. IT SHALL BE STUMPS ON DAY 3.

Welcome back for the final session. The players and umpires are making their way out to the middle. It shall be JASON HOLDER to start proceedings after tea.
.....DAY 3, SESSION 3.....

The deficit is now 24 and the hosts have all the wickets in the tank. Pakistan will be determined to get to the lead without losing any wickets if possible and then build on from there. West Indies will hope for quick strikes after tea. Join us in a while for the final session.

A fairly good session for Pakistan. Firstly, they bowled the Windies out without conceding too much of a first innings lead. Wahab finished with a 5-fer. Then, their openers managed to play out the tricky passage of play till tea without being separated.
